item.text: [{"task_id":"e57337a4","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    marker = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    block = max(1, abs(int(round(params['rule'][1]))))","    height, width = grid.shape","    rows = max(1, height // block)","    cols = max(1, width // block)","    background = int(np.argmax(np.bincount(grid.flatten())))","    output = np.full((rows, cols), background)","    for r in range(rows):","        for c in range(cols):","            region = grid[r * block:min((r + 1) * block, height), c * block:min((c + 1) * block, width)]","            if np.any(region == marker):","                output[r, c] = marker","    return output"],"shapes":{"rule":[2]},"params":{"rule":[0,5]},"rationale":"Compress each 5-by-5 region into one cell, preserving the background color unless that region contains a black marker.
